description: This file defines the GDPR model class for the Opencart admin module, providing methods to manipulate GDPR-related records in the database, including editing status, deleting records, fetching records with filters, and retrieving expiration data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class managing GDPR data for customers, including CRUD operations and filtering of GDPR records.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record based on gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all GDPR records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records applying optional filters such as email, action, status, date range, and pagination.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Fetches a single GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Returns the total count of GDPR records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records with status '2' (presumably expired) that are due to expire based on configurable days.
